You: So, how was your dish? 
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: It was great! I can’t quite put my finger on it, but I think it would taste quite nice to an average human being.
You: W-well, that must have been quite tasty indeed…
Her description isn’t really appetizing, but I can’t expect much from a sexbot in this matter.
You: Alright. Are you ready to go?
Bot: Yes. I’m full.
You: Check please!
